item.title: 10 years after PFAS discovery, Fountain Valley marks major progress
item.description: Fountain Valley leaders are marking a decade of progress following the discovery of PFAS contamination in local groundwater. Ten years after the chemicals were first detected, the region has transitioned from temporary filtration systems to permanent treatment facilities and diversified water sources to ensure water safety.
